result: End-to-end PostgreSQL suite 11/11 at 0fe7644: comparisons with 2 and 4 participants frozen through the wired API, one fixed evaluation per participant enqueued by the driver and run on the real worker, finalized to COMPLETE with outcome NO_QUALIFIED_RESULT; participant run failure and cancellation, admission refusal classes, bounded finalizer retry, record replay MATCH, MISMATCH and REPRODUCTION_DISABLED, old engine hash refusals and flag-off paths covered. Owner API suite 14/14 (real server, owner scope on every participant, CSRF, identical 404 for foreign and absent ids, read-only view by row digests); UI JSDOM tests and the rendered check; engine identities foundation, ingestion, pf2_engine and fixed_eval rotated with new pins, legacy, trace, pf2_evaluator and mp-package-trace unchanged and asserted, mp-combined newly pinned. CI passed all 9 checks on 0d51ed3, ce66c78, 32ec0d8 and 0fe7644 (read by root via the REST check-runs).
limits: STANDARDIZED only; ACTUAL_BOT not implemented (contract RC-C42 and owner decision OD-C20: after QR-2 S3). Root ruling SB188 (RR-7) allows stage I without it.
Labelled fixtures only; every outcome is NO_QUALIFIED_RESULT under the V8 hold (R1); OPEN-1 and OPEN-2 fail closed; no qualified label, rank or apply.
Record replay only: it re-verifies stored results and data; it does not re-run the Python evaluator (contract I4 engine re-run not built).

MUST-FIX before the V8 hold lifts or a gate snapshot is added (SB187): participant inputs pass empty earlier holdouts and searched windows and a null registered boundary; an unreadable prior-exposure register falls back to development evidence.

Other recorded limitations: replay marks transient database errors as REPRODUCTION_DISABLED; admission retries non-application errors without a bound; finalizer header comments stale; driver stop has no abort; audit rows only for committed create or cancel; evidence class, robustness rows and rank not shown in the UI.

Release only with REPIN-3 under its own owner GOs; comparisons frozen before the identity rotation cannot be evaluated; the staging drain-or-cancel choice stays with the owner. Thai UI text awaits owner review before staging.
